name: agentos-desktop
description: Thin Electron wrapper that launches the Chomp board as a local Mac app. See AGENTS.md and README.md at the repo root for what it wraps.

scripts.install-app: npm run build && mkdir -p "${CHOMP_APPS_DIR:-$HOME/Applications}" && rsync -a --delete dist/mac*/Chomp.app "${CHOMP_APPS_DIR:-$HOME/Applications}/" && echo "Installed to ${CHOMP_APPS_DIR:-$HOME/Applications}/Chomp.app"
